title: Neutron stars have intense gravity, bending spacetime around them.
narration: Neutron stars are incredibly dense, packing a sun's mass into a city-sized sphere. Their powerful gravity warps spacetime, causing light to curve and time to slow down. This demonstrates the effects of general relativity in the universe's most extreme environments.
